name: dispatch_actor_command_state
description: Runs the shared actor command dispatcher, which reads a command code and branches to one of several cases that update the actor's status bytes and the party table. Before dispatch it copies a pending value into the active field, and the text 'AMOUNT-' is referenced on this path.

name: dispatch_actor_command_with_delay
description: Copies a pending value into the actor's active field, runs the shared actor command dispatcher, then spins a long countdown loop that clears one actor status byte on each pass. The countdown uses a 32-bit global counter.

name: deduct_slot_from_four_keys
description: Maps the pressed key code to a table slot index, then subtracts the actor's decimal amount from that slot when the slot holds at least that much, and runs the shared dispatcher. The 'G,K,P,T:' prompt text is referenced on this path.

name: deduct_slot_from_three_keys
description: Maps one of three key codes to a table slot index, subtracts the actor's decimal amount from that slot when it holds enough, and runs the shared dispatcher.

name: deduct_slot_from_two_keys
description: Maps one of two key codes to a table slot index, subtracts the actor's decimal amount from that slot when it holds enough, and runs the shared dispatcher.

name: deduct_slot_from_one_key
description: Maps a single key code to a fixed table slot index, subtracts the actor's decimal amount from that slot when it holds enough, and runs the shared dispatcher.

name: dispatch_actor_command_entry
description: Makes one unnamed call, then runs the shared actor command dispatcher.

name: deduct_indexed_slot_for_quantity
description: Takes a slot index from a register, subtracts the decimal amount from that table entry when the entry holds enough, and then runs the shared dispatcher. The text 'HOW MANY-' is referenced, which matches a quantity prompt.

name: store_table_entry_and_dispatch
description: Stores the input byte into a table entry chosen by an index register, copies the pending value into the actor's active field, and runs the shared actor command dispatcher.

name: consume_selected_weapon_item
description: Accepts a selection byte only within a fixed range, maps it to a weapon table entry, and decrements that decimal count when it is not zero. The 'WHICH WEAPON:' prompt text is referenced on this path.

name: decrement_selected_weapon_count
description: Decrements the decimal count of the entry that the stored selection points to, unless the count is already zero, then sets the actor's active field and runs the shared dispatcher.

name: handle_actor_command_entry
description: Makes several unnamed calls, then runs the shared actor command dispatcher.

name: consume_selected_armour_item
description: Accepts a selection byte only within a fixed range, maps it to an armour table entry, and decrements that count when it is nonzero. The 'WHICH ARMOUR:' prompt text is referenced on this path.

name: store_decremented_table_entry
description: Stores the input byte minus one into a table entry chosen by an index register, then runs the shared actor command dispatcher.

name: run_actor_command_loop
description: Makes a few unnamed calls and then runs the shared actor command dispatcher, with no extra logic of its own.

name: subtract_bcd_pair_from_table
description: Stores two byte arguments into the actor's fields, then subtracts an amount from a two-byte packed decimal table entry with borrow between the bytes. The entry is written only when it covers the amount; otherwise the routine returns 255 and leaves the entry unchanged.

name: decrement_slot_fifteen_conditionally
description: Decrements the decimal value at table index fifteen only when a status byte is in one particular state and that value is nonzero, and when it does, sets an actor timer to 255 and runs the shared dispatcher.

name: consume_torch_and_set_timer
description: Decrements the decimal value at table index fifteen when it is nonzero and sets an actor timer to 255. The 'WHOSE TORCH-' prompt text is referenced on this path.

name: decrement_slot_fifteen_count
description: Decrements the decimal value at table index fifteen when it is nonzero, sets an actor timer to 255, and then runs the shared dispatcher.

name: run_common_actor_update
description: Makes an unnamed call and then enters the shared actor command dispatcher, with no extra logic of its own.

name: set_slot_fifteen_from_input
description: Stores the input byte minus one, adjusted to packed decimal, into table index fifteen, then sets an actor timer to 255 and runs the shared dispatcher.

name: combine_packed_totals_for_join
description: Checks a count against an actor limit, then adds two packed decimal counters across a range of party table entries into combined totals, clearing the sources as it goes. The 'Join gold to-' prompt text is referenced on this path.

name: merge_packed_totals_if_fits
description: When the input count is within the actor's limit, adds two packed decimal counters across party table entries into combined totals, then writes those totals back into the table.

name: accumulate_packed_totals_loop
description: Clears two packed decimal accumulators on the actor, then loops over party table entries adding their two counters into the accumulators, clearing each source as it goes.

name: enter_actor_update_handler
description: Makes a few unnamed calls and then runs the shared actor command dispatcher, with no extra logic of its own.

name: run_look_command_prompt
description: Makes six unnamed calls, then runs the shared actor command dispatcher. The 'Look-' prompt text is referenced on this path.

name: format_long_value_as_digits
description: Converts a long value into a fixed-width buffer of ASCII digit characters, padding leading positions with zero characters and propagating carries, and returns a count.

name: format_register_value_as_digits
description: Converts a value passed in registers into a fixed-width buffer of ASCII digit characters, padding leading positions with zero characters, and returns a count.

name: emit_padding_then_digits
description: Writes a counted run of ASCII zero characters into a text buffer, calling another routine between writes, and then emits the remaining digits.

name: emit_digit_run_from_buffer
description: Copies a digit run from a text buffer into an output area, fills the remaining positions with ASCII zero characters, and returns the digit count.

name: emit_zero_fill_digit_run
description: Writes ASCII zero characters into a text buffer from a start position up to its fixed width, then copies the digit run to an output area and returns the digit count.

name: emit_nibble_digit_run
description: Writes the low digit value of a register into successive positions of a text buffer as ASCII characters up to its fixed width, then copies the digit run to an output area.

name: delay_by_counting_down
description: Decrements a 16-bit register in a loop until it reaches zero, then returns. It does nothing else.

name: multiply_long_value_by_ten
description: Multiplies a 64-bit value held in two registers by ten, using shifts and additions with carry propagation, and returns the result in the same register pair.

name: divide_long_value_by_ten
description: Divides a 64-bit value by ten bit by bit, keeping the quotient in the registers and the remainder in a separate word.

name: divide_signed_long_words
description: Divides one signed 32-bit value by another with a 32-step restoring loop and applies the sign of the result afterwards. It returns zero when either input is zero.

name: store_global_parameter_value
description: Stores its single argument in a global variable and returns.

name: unpack_double_mantissa_bits
description: Shifts bits from the low word into the mantissa of the high word over ten positions and sets the leading bit, returning the pair. A zero mantissa returns zero.

name: set_leading_mantissa_bit
description: Performs the same ten-position shift without the zero check and returns only the high word with its leading bit set.

name: normalize_double_with_exponent
description: Normalizes a 64-bit mantissa by shifting until its leading bit is set, adjusts the exponent with the double-precision bias, and calls an unnamed error routine with code 1 on underflow or code 2 on overflow.

name: pack_normalized_double_result
description: Shifts a double-precision mantissa left until its leading bit is set, adjusts the exponent, and packs the high word. It reports underflow with error code 1 and overflow with error code 2.

name: signal_error_and_return_zero
description: Reports error code 1 to an unnamed routine and returns zero.

name: signal_error_return_infinity
description: Reports error code 2 to an unnamed routine and returns a double with an all-ones exponent and zero mantissa, which is the overflow value.

name: parse_arguments_and_open_streams
description: Splits the command line into argument pointers, treating double-quoted text as one argument, then opens the input and output streams through the DOS library calls and records the process's file handles.

name: check_signal_and_dispatch
description: Reads the task's signal bits with a system call and returns zero when the masked bits are clear. When they are set, it calls a routine with a fixed code, picks one of two fixed codes from one bit, calls a routine for each index below a global count, and returns the result of a final call.

name: allocate_block_from_free_list
description: Searches a global free list for a block of at least the requested size, unlinks it when it fits exactly or splits off the requested units otherwise, and reduces a global free-unit total. It returns null when the size is below one or no block fits.

name: call_forward_with_repeated_size
description: Calls another routine with its first argument and its second argument repeated, then returns.

name: insert_block_into_free_list
description: Inserts a block into the address-sorted global free list, merging it with an adjacent block when they touch and updating a global free-unit total. It rejects the insertion, undoing the total, when the block would run into an existing free block, and returns minus one.

name: pass_argument_twice_forward
description: Passes its single 32-bit argument to another routine as both arguments, then returns.

name: shift_global_counter_left_three
description: Returns a global counter shifted left by three bits, with no other work.
